
```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("tbl.PSA.sites")
if (!exists("Vs30.docx", inherits = FALSE)) Vs30.docx <- 800
if (!exists("PSA_Units") || !length(PSA_Units)) PSA_Units <- "cm/s2"
if (!exists("Tn.target") || !length(Tn.target)) Tn.target <- Tn.gmdp
if (!exists("TR.target") || !length(TR.target)) TR.target <- TR.MDE
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target))  p.target  <- "mean"
Vs30.target <- Vs30.docx
Sites.caption <- paste(siteID.target, collapse = ", ")
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "PSA.sites.qmd",
  base = TRUE,
  target = Target,
  siteID = siteID.target
)
root <- here::here()
```
